key_insight: Local neighborhoods of peers in a decentralized learning network reveal consistency patterns: benign nodes agree with their neighbors on model behavior while backdoored nodes produce detectable local anomalies. Argus leverages these neighborhood agreements to detect backdoors without a central server.
problem_solved: Detecting stealthy backdoor attacks in decentralized (serverless) collaborative learning where global coordination or centralized inspection is unavailable and privacy/data-sharing constraints limit conventional defenses.
method: Each node compares its model behavior (predictions or representations) with immediate neighbors on a small set of probe or unlabeled inputs to estimate pairwise agreement.
Aggregate local agreement scores into neighborhood-consensus statistics and apply lightweight anomaly detection to identify nodes whose behavior deviates significantly from their neighbors.

Mitigate detected threats by isolating or downweighting suspicious peers in local aggregation, preserving privacy by exchanging only compact signals (e.g., outputs/embeddings or similarity scores) rather than raw data.
impact: Provides a practical, privacy-friendly defense that fits DL constraints (no central server, limited data sharing), enabling practitioners to detect and mitigate backdoors in distributed collaborations while maintaining model utility.
visual_elements: Network diagram showing a node and its local neighborhood with arrows indicating pairwise agreement checks and a flagged suspicious peer.
Pipeline flowchart of Argus: probe inputs → neighbor comparisons → consensus scoring → anomaly detection → mitigation.
Heatmap or bar chart of neighborhood agreement scores highlighting anomalies (high contrast between benign and backdoored nodes).
ROC-like curve or schematic showing trade-off between detection rate and false positives (conceptual, not numeric).
paper_title: Your Neighbors Know: Leveraging Local Neighborhoods for Backdoor Detection in Decentralized Learning
paper_authors: Sayan Biswas, Antoine Boutet, Davide Frey, Romaric Gaudel, Rachid Guerraoui
